sql: CREATE TABLE thoughts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, friend_id TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'casual', due_at TEXT, schedule_id TEXT, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'model', said_at TEXT, expires_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT, origin_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, origin_product_id TEXT NOT NULL);
